positions.name: SprintFourEvidenceForThesis
positions.frame: does the Sprint 4 retro's shipped-feature, velocity, and integration evidence confirm the anti-Slack decision-capture thesis?
positions.why: Tanya's three statements — the widget shipped, velocity hit a quarterly high, and the Zephyr integration was the key unlock — read together as one directional claim: the sprint's concrete delivery, metric, and technical unlock are being offered as proof-points for the anti-Slack, zero-extra-step positioning thesis. No existing position in the consult (empty) can be attached or revised, so this reading is freshly minted from the sprint retro segments alone.
